programme.title: The Gentle Trap

programme.title: Out of Town

programme.title: Gaolbreak

programme.title: Alma Cogan Live in 1959
programme.desc: 1959. A spectacular musical variety show hosted by the brilliant Alma Cogan, who presents a number of talented stars including Cliff Richard and the Shadows, Billy Baxter and Wilbur Evans.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: A Clean Break. 1976. Stars Patrick O'Connell, Jennifer Wilson & Michael Elwyn. Edward and Jennifer's worst fears have been realised, and William's natural mother has asked for him back.

programme.title: Look At Life Woman Power
programme.desc: 1960. Author and broadcaster Stephen Potter shows why no man should ever underestimate the spending power of women in modern Britain, with a look at women's influence on the retail trade.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: 1951. Comedy. Director: Vincente Minnelli. Stars Elizabeth Taylor, Spencer Tracy & Joan Bennett. Stanley Banks is still recovering from his daughter's wedding when he learns that she is pregnant.

programme.title: Autobiography of a Princess
programme.desc: 1975. Drama. Director: James Ivory. Stars James Mason & Madhur Jaffrey. Divorced and living in exile in London, an Indian princess recollects about her past life in Royal India.

programme.title: Strange But True

programme.title: Man Accused

programme.title: Food Flash Chester Orange Juice
programme.desc: 1945. In this charming short video Charlie Chester promotes the importance of orange juice for children under five.

programme.title: Van der Valk

programme.title: The Death of Adolf Hitler

programme.title: Death Goes To School

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies

programme.title: Look At Life Crossing The Channel
programme.desc: 1962. A look at why people from all over the world attempt to swim the English Channel.

programme.title: The Trial of Madame X

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green

programme.title: Piccadilly Incident

programme.title: Crown Court
